body.content: Exploration of the 13-point Heilbronn problem. A symmetric construction (4 corners, 4 edge midpoints, 1 center, 4 inner satellites at 0.25/0.75) yields many collinear triples (e.g., (0,0), (0.5,0), (1,0)). If the checker enforces strict non-collinearity via minimum area > 0, this scores 0. To fix this, we must perturb the points. An asymmetric perturbation might yield a score around 0.01 to 0.02. The theoretical maximum for 13 points is unknown but conjectured to be small. A random or lattice-based perturbation could be simulated to find the optimal minimum area.
body.possible_next_move: Run a simulation to randomly perturb the symmetric 13-point grid and calculate the resulting minimum triangle area to find a better score.
